lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Long arm to sloped middle, about 45 deg (incl 134.7). In my perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer convex skin at the arc minimum (nearest scan point 0.23/0.05/0.26 mm; the inner skin is 6.4 mm away along the bisector, so the label is on the outer skin and not mid-thickness). It is parallel to the fold axis. The 24.2 mm line covers about 92% of the roughly 26.3 mm visible fold width (the shortfall is the rounded side edges).

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Sloped middle to the short holed end arm, about 45 deg of opposite sense (incl 135.3), the second bend of the joggle. Sections at 25/50/75% put the label at the outer apex (nearest point 0.09/0.18/0.08 mm, centred on the symmetric arc). It is parallel. The 23.1 mm line covers about 89% of the roughly 25.8 mm visible width. The holes lie on the end arm, outside the bend zone.
